text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask a voice assistant a question, get movie recommendations, unlock a phone with our face, or receive a translation on a travel app. AI is changing the way we live and work.
